name: Rameses
line: Rameses was a district and city in Egypt where Joseph settled his family, and later the starting point of Israel's journey out of Egypt.

moments.title: Joseph settles his family
moments.text: Joseph settled his father and brothers in the best part of Egypt, the district of Rameses, as Pharaoh had commanded. He also gave them food for their families.

moments.title: Israel leaves Egypt
moments.text: The Israelites set out from Rameses for Succoth. About 600,000 men on foot went, besides women and children.

moments.title: A bold march out
moments.text: The Israelites marched out of Rameses in full view of the Egyptians, who were burying their firstborn that the LORD had struck down. Then Israel camped at Succoth.
